caption: The video captures a close, low-angle view of a dark, round cooking surface on which two irregular patches of pale, bubble-textured substance sit and simmer. The left patch rests toward the upper-left. The larger right patch occupies the center, marked by a small dark notch along its upper edge. The patches hold their positions throughout, yet the foam within them shifts subtly frame to frame, tiny bubbles forming and settling as the substance continues to bubble on the heated surface. A bright glint flickers along the lower edge of the left patch. In the blurred foreground at the bottom center lies a pale yellow stick-like object, motionless and out of focus. The pan rim and the soft, out-of-focus light wall behind it remain constant, framing the quiet, ongoing simmering.
